answer_1.quote: Generating a natural language summary to explain a chart has numerous benefits and potential applications... In this paper, we present a neural model for chart summarization...

answer_2.quote: For automated evaluation of our summary quality, we employ two different metrics: (1) the BLEU score, and (2) a content selection metric inspired by [Gong et al.].

answer_4.quote: We created a Mechanical Turk study and surveyed three unique respondents per statistic. We use the survey to assess the quality of each summary from four independent perspectives...
answer_4.guideline: Assess quality on informativeness, conciseness, coherence, fluency, and factuality using survey questions
